name: Golden Designs Hanko 2-3 Person Indoor Traditional Sauna
description: Golden Designs Hanko Edition 2-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna Crafted with precision and care, the Hanko sauna offer the perfect escape to a world of tranquility and rejuvenation. Elevate your well-being and embrace the art of relaxation in a healthier way with the Golden Designs Hanko. Luxurious Design: The all-glass front and right-side wall creates an open and inviting atmosphere. The stunning Canadian Red Cedar interior is complemented by the all-Canadian Hemlock exterior finished in a clear stain. This traditional steam sauna brings a touch of elegance that complements any home decor. Therapeutic Steam Experience: The Golden Designs Hanko Edition sauna envelops your body in a delightfully relaxing mist, promoting relaxation and stress relief. Feel the tension and fatigue melt away in your very own home spa as the steam therapy soothes sore muscles and enhances blood circulation. Feel the health benefits as you detoxify your body and rejuvenate your soul in this traditional steam sauna. Unmatched Craftsmanship: The Hanko Edition Sauna is a testament to expert craftsmanship and attention to detail. The spacious interior comfortably accommodates two people, making it the perfect sanctuary to share with a loved one. The interior LED lighting sets the perfect mood for relaxation. Your Personal Wellness Retreat: Transform your home into a personal wellness retreat with the Golden Designs Hanko 2-Person Traditional Steam Sauna. Whether you seek to unwind after a long day, alleviate stress, or enhance your overall well-being, this invigorating steam sauna is your gateway to a life of indulgence and healthier living. Elevate Your Lifestyle: Create cherished moments of tranquility and well-being with the beautifully designed and expertly crafted Golden Designs Hanko Edition sauna—your personal oasis of serenity and luxury. Features 2-3 person capacity 100% Natural Canadian Red Cedar Wood Interior / Canadian Hemlock Wood Exterior Oversize interior chromotherapy lighting system (Red Light Therapy Feature Starting in 2024 Models) Interior backrest with accent lighting Interior LED Control Panel with built-in FM Radio and Bluetooth Connection Built-in Performance Speakers Sandglass, bucket, and scoop Stainless steel hinge and handle Harvia SWS60 The Wall 6 kW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built-in Controls Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 30AMP (Stove) and 120V / 15AMP (Control for Lights and Music). Please consult a certified electrician. Assembled Dimensions (W x D x H): 64" x 48" x 78" Assembled Weight 525 LBS Shipping Weight 675 LBS All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your prefabricated saunas today and experience the Golden Designs difference.
